name: BrightEdge Autopilot Page Publisher
author: Alok Tiwari

sections.description:
The BrightEdge Autopilot Page Publisher is a comprehensive WordPress module that seamlessly integrates with the BrightEdge SEO platform to enable automated content optimisation and SEO management. This module provides a powerful bridge between your WordPress content management system and BrightEdge’s advanced SEO recommendations, allowing for real-time updates of page titles, meta descriptions, H1 tags, and other critical SEO elements through both manual interface, BrightEdge Platform and BrightEdge Chrome Extension as well.

The module enhances your content editing experience with live Google SERP previews and provides a secure bridge to update content meta information via BrightEdge Platform and Chrome extension, making it an essential tool for SEO professionals and content managers who want to leverage BrightEdge’s AI-powered SEO recommendations directly within their WordPress workflow.

Features

  • Live Google SERP Preview: Real-time preview of how your content will appear in search results
  • Integrated Meta Tag Editing: Seamless editing of SEO titles and meta descriptions within content forms
  • H1 Tag Optimization: Update page headings based on BrightEdge recommendations
  • XPath Element Support: Advanced content targeting using XPath selectors for precise element updates
  • Schema: Perform / Add JSON-LD Schema on any type of page.

Plugin License

The code of this plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 (or later) license, meaning you are free to modify, redistribute, and use it according to the terms of the GPL.

Branding Assets License:

All branding assets, including logos and images, are owned by BrightEdge Technologies inc and are provided under a proprietary license. These assets cannot be used for other purposes outside of this plugin without permission from BrightEdge Technologies inc.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin’s Zip file & upload into WordPress site & activate.
  2. Create/View a User with atleast Admin/Editor Role, scroll below to generate Application Password.
  3. Remember to copy this password as it won’t be shown again.
  4. Submit the Required fields at BrightEdge Platform to utlise the page publisher.

Version 1.17.0 (2025-07-27)

  • WordPress PCP standards fixes.

Version 1.16.0 (2025-06-26)

  • Added content JSON Schema addition API

  • added query params support with whitelist for params.
  • Modified conditions for robust validation & checking.
  • Fixed caching issues on page validation.

Version 1.13.0 (2025-05-05)

  • Added an API to update content on basis of XPath without validation of original value (forcefully).

Version 1.12.0 (2025-04-30)

  • Added BEAPP DB table.
  • Added an API to update content on basis of XPath.
  • Overriding of pages on basis of XPath and its values.

Version 1.11.0 (2025-04-15)

  • Coding structural fixes.

Version 1.10.0 (2025-02-11)

  • Updated coding standards as per WordPress.
  • Minor compatibility changes.

Version 1.9.0 (2025-01-09)

  • Fixed Homepage Meta not updating issue.
  • Updated coding standards as per WordPress.
  • Minor compatibility changes.
  • Updated readme & plugin definitions as per followed standards.

Version 1.8.0 (2025-01-03)

  • Updated Styles / UI for ediorial section for posts & taxonomy.
  • Updated fields & UI of Dedicated configuration page as well.
  • Added Live preview snippet field in all of the BEAPP editoral sections.

Version 1.7.0 (2024-12-26)

  • Note – This remains as an internal development version.
  • Dispalys Editorial Dashboard / section For Posts, Pages & custom post types.
  • Dispalys Editorial Dashboard / section For Tags, Categories & custom taxonomies.
  • Updating title & meta description through ediorial CMS is now supported.
  • Dedicated configuration page for BrightEdge SEO for homepage meta settings.
  • @Todo – The UI of the dashboard will be updated.

Version 1.6.0 (2024-12-24)

  • Rectified error responses HTTP status codes to 200, except authentication errors.
  • Added “status” flag in “get meta” API
  • Added “is_h1_publishing_supported” flag in “get meta” to check H1 Republish supportability.

Version 1.5.0 (2024-11-06)

  • H1 updates on taxonomy terms are now permanent and is updated on the ediorial/backend view.
  • Title & Metatag updates for Homepage is now supported.
  • Title & Metatag updates for Post type archive pages is now supported.
  • Fixed issue with custom taxonomy slug not being identified.
  • Shows error response for search page as its not supported.
  • Known limitations – H1 updates for Homepage and Post type archive pages is not supported. H1 updates on taxonomy only works for title of the taxonomy term as update on editorial/backend is required.

Version 1.4.0 (2024-10-29)

  • Update H1 for WordPress Posts, pages & taxonomy as well.
  • H1 updated on Posts & pages will be saved in the post content (Permanently changes into the post).
  • H1 updated on taxonomy won’t be permanently updated.
  • Known issue – Republish on same taxonomy won’t work as we won’t have actual H1 (Source of truth).

Version 1.3.0 (2024-10-21)

  • Fixed third-party SEO plugin conflicting issues.
  • Removed redundant code related to update meta values of Yoast and AIOSEO plugins.
  • Normalised H1 values for better replacement.

Version 1.2.0 (2024-10-14)

  • Added H1 tag replacement feature
  • Updated error response messages

Version 1.0.0 (2024-08-19)

  • Initial release
